title: VaultShopLite
description: Simple GUI shop powered by Vault economy.
body:
# VaultShopLite

Simple GUI shop powered by Vault economy.

## Features
- Config-driven GUI shop.
- Vault economy integration.
- Custom item names and lore.
- Easy prices and slots configuration.

## Command
- `/shop | /shop reload`

## Permissions
- `vaultshoplite.use`
- `vaultshoplite.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
gui.title: "&6Server Shop"
items.diamond.price: 100.0
items.diamond.slot: 10
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4
